inputs.text: [curious] LIS… troh… SOR… us. "Lystron," in Greek, means shovel. [serious] And "saurus," lizard.
[happily] That's the one — because of his snout, [serious] wide and flat, like a little shovel. He lived two hundred fifty million years ago — [amazed] before the dinosaurs.
[amazed] Almost everywhere: South Africa, Antarctica, India, China, Russia, Mongolia. [serious] Back then, all the land was stuck together [confident] in one single piece.
